title: ConstituentRead
description: Constituents are the individuals and organizations who support your organization by contributing time, money, and resources. The constituent entity stores information about donors, prospects, volunteers, general supporters, and more.

id.description: The immutable system record ID for the constituent. This is not the same as the user-definable constituent identifier, which is stored in the lookup_id.

age.description: This computed field calculates the constituent's age based on the birthdate property. For individuals only.

birthdate.description: The constituent's birthdate. For individuals only.

date_added.description: The date when the constituent was created. Includes an offset from UTC in ISO-8601 format: 1969-11-21T10:29:43-04:00.

date_modified.description: The date when the constituent was last modified. Includes an offset from UTC in ISO-8601 format: 1969-11-21T10:29:43-04:00.

deceased.description: Indicates whether the constituent is deceased. For individuals only.

deceased_date.description: The date when the constituent died. For individuals only.

email.description: The constituent's primary email address, or the constituent's first active email address if no active email address is marked as primary.

first.description: The constituent's first name. For individuals only.

former_name.description: The constituent's former name. For individuals only.

fundraiser_status.description: Indicates whether the constituent is a fundraiser. For individuals only.

gender.description: The constituent's gender. Available values are the entries in the Gender table. This property defaults to unknown if no value is provided. For individuals only.

gives_anonymously.description: Indicates whether the constituent gives anonymously.

inactive.description: Indicates whether the constituent is inactive.

last.description: The constituent's last name. For individuals only.

lookup_id.description: The user-defined identifier for the constituent.

marital_status.description: The constituent's marital status. Available values are the entries in the Marital Status table. For individuals only.

middle.description: The constituent's middle name. For individuals only.

name.description: If the constituent's type is Individual, this computed field indicates the full name of the constituent based on the target organization’s display name settings. If the type is Organization, this is the organization's name.

online_presence.description: The constituent's primary online presence, or the constituent's first active online presence if no active online presence is marked as primary.

phone.description: The constituent's primary phone, or the constituent's first active phone if no active phone is marked as primary.

preferred_name.description: The constituent's preferred name. For individuals only.

spouse.description: This computed field retrieves information about the constituent's spouse using the constituent's relationships. For individuals only.

suffix.description: The constituent's primary suffix. Available values are the entries in the Suffixes table. For individuals only.

suffix_2.description: The constituent's secondary suffix. Available values are the entries in the Suffixes table. For individuals only.

title.description: The constituent's primary title. Available values are the entries in the Titles table. For individuals only.

title_2.description: The constituent's secondary title. Available values are the entries in the Titles table. For individuals only.

type.description: The type of constituent. Available values are Individual and Organization.

birthplace.description: The birthplace of the constituent. For individuals only.

ethnicity.description: The ethnicity of the constituent. For individuals only.

income.description: The income for the constituent. For individuals only.

religion.description: The religion of the constituent. For individuals only.

industry.description: The industry of the constituent. For organizations only.

matches_gifts.description: Indicates if the constituent matches gifts. For organizations only.

matching_gift_per_gift_min.description: The minimum matching gift per gift for the constituent. For organizations only.

matching_gift_per_gift_max.description: The maximum matching gift per gift for the constituent. For organizations only.

matching_gift_total_min.description: The minimum matching gift total for the constituent. For organizations only.

matching_gift_total_max.description: The maximum matching gift total for the constituent. For organizations only.

matching_gift_factor.description: The matching gift factor for the constituent. For organizations only.

matching_gift_notes.description: The matching gift notes for the constituent. For organizations only.

num_employees.description: The number of employees for the constituent. For organizations only.

is_memorial.description: Indicates whether the constituent is for honor/memorial.

is_solicitor.description: Indicates whether the constituent is a solicitor.

no_valid_address.description: Indicates whether the constituent does not have a valid address.

receipt_type.description: The receipt type of the constituent.

requests_no_email.description: Indicates whether the constituent requests no email.

import_id.description: The import id for the constituent.

is_constituent.description: Flag indicating whether or not this individual or organization is a constituent

num_subsidiaries.description: The number of subsidiaries for the constituent. For organizations only.

parent_corporation_name.description: The parent corporation name of the constituent. For organizations only.

parent_corporation_id.description: The parent corporation identifier of the constituent. For organizations only.

AddressRead.description: Addresses store information about constituent residences and other addresses along with information about where or whether to send mail.

id.description: The immutable system record ID of the address.

constituent_id.description: The immutable system record ID of the constituent associated with the address.

date_added.description: The date when the address was created. Includes an offset from UTC in ISO-8601 format: 1969-11-21T10:29:43-04:00.

date_modified.description: The date when the address was last modified. Includes an offset from UTC in ISO-8601 format: 1969-11-21T10:29:43-04:00.

do_not_mail.description: Indicates whether the constituent requests not to be contacted at this address.

end.description: The date when the constituent ceased to reside at this address. Uses ISO-8601 format: 1969-11-21T10:29:43.

formatted_address.description: This computed field retrieves the formatted address in the configured format of the country.

inactive.description: This computed field indicates that the address is active if the current date is before any end date.

postal_code.description: The postal code of the address.

preferred.description: Indicates whether this is the constituent's preferred address.

seasonal_end.description: The time of the year ceases to reside at this address.

seasonal_start.description: The time of year that the constituent begins residing at this address.

start.description: The date when the constituent began residing at this address. Uses ISO-8601 format: 1969-11-21T10:29:43.

type.description: The address type. Available values are the entries in the Address Types table.

AddressRead.x-additional-info:
Some Address entity properties include international address support.

Property United States Canada United Kingdom Australia New Zealand
address_lines
city *
suburb
state !
postal_code
county
country

* Australia — For GET operations, the city property returns city or suburb data. For POST and PATCH operations, you can use either the suburb or city properties, but not both. An error occurs if you provide values for both properties.

! Canada — Use the state property to track provinces.

Currency.description: For consistency, currency is configured at the organization level. This ensures that all monetary amounts are consistent, regardless of where they are entered or viewed.

EmailAddressRead.description: Email addresses store information about constituent email accounts and where to send email correspondences for individuals and organizations.

id.description: The immutable system record ID of the email address.

constituent_id.description: The immutable system record ID of the constituent associated with the email address.

date_added.description: The date when the email address was created. Includes an offset from UTC in ISO-8601 format: 1969-11-21T10:29:43-04:00.

date_modified.description: The date when the email address was last modified. Includes an offset from UTC in ISO-8601 format: 1969-11-21T10:29:43-04:00.

do_not_email.description: Indicates whether the constituent requests not to be contacted at this email address.

inactive.description: Indicates whether the email address is inactive.

primary.description: Indicates whether this is the constituent's primary email address.

type.description: The type of email address. Available values are the entries in the Phone Types table.

FuzzyDate.description: Fuzzy dates provide a versatile date type to create partial dates such as February 9 (with no year indicated).

d.description: The day in the fuzzy date.

m.description: The month in the fuzzy date.

y.description: The year in the fuzzy date.

OnlinePresenceRead.description: Online presence entities store a constituent’s social media accounts, websites, and other means of reaching out or gaining more information about the constituent.

id.description: The immutable system record ID of the online presence.

address.description: The web address for the online presence.

constituent_id.description: The immutable system record ID of the constituent associated with the online presence.

date_added.description: The date when the online presence was created. Includes an offset from UTC in ISO-8601 format: 1969-11-21T10:29:43-04:00.

date_modified.description: The date when the online presence was last modified. Includes an offset from UTC in ISO-8601 format: 1969-11-21T10:29:43-04:00.

inactive.description: Indicates whether the online presence is inactive.

primary.description: Indicates whether this is the constituent's primary online presence.

type.description: The online presence type. Available values are the entries in the Phone Types table.

PhoneRead.description: Phones store information about constituent phone numbers and where to call individuals and organizations.

id.description: The immutable system record ID of the phone.

constituent_id.description: The immutable system record ID of the constituent associated with the phone.

date_added.description: The date when the phone was created. Includes an offset from UTC in ISO-8601 format: 1969-11-21T10:29:43-04:00.

date_modified.description: The date when the phone was last modified. Includes an offset from UTC in ISO-8601 format: 1969-11-21T10:29:43-04:00.

do_not_call.description: Indicates whether the constituent requests not to be contacted at this number.

inactive.description: Indicates whether the phone is inactive.

primary.description: Indicates whether this is the constituent's primary phone.

type.description: The phone type. Available values are the entries in the Phone Types table.

SpouseRead.description: The spouse entity describes spouses for individual constituents.

id.description: The immutable system record ID of the spouse.

is_head_of_household.description: Indicates whether the spouse is the head household. Only applies to constituent spouses.
